title: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill
abstract: arXiv:2608.11924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Turning a research idea into a complete paper requires more than text generation: the system must retrieve literature, design and execute experiments, revise claims according to evidence, produce publication-ready figures, and maintain consistency across a long generation process. We present Spark-to-Paper, an end-to-end research paper generation system implemented as thirteen composable skills inside an existing coding assistant, without requiring a separate agent platform or orchestration service. Spark-to-Paper separates model-based judgment from deterministic operations that can be directly executed and checked. It further separates experiment planning from reporting, so that required evidence is specified before results are observed and manuscript claims are revised according to measured outcomes. To improve reliability over long research trajectories, the system combines deterministic integrity checks with self-critique and bounds

translated_title: 从火花到论文：作为可组合技能实现的端到端研究论文生成
translated_abstract: 将研究想法转化为完整论文所需的不只是文本生成：系统必须检索文献、设计并执行实验、根据证据修正主张、生成可发表质量的图表，并在漫长的生成过程中保持一致性。我们提出了Spark-to-Paper，一个端到端的研究论文生成系统，它作为现有编码助手内的十三个可组合技能实现，无需独立的代理平台或编排服务。Spark-to-Paper将基于模型的判断与可直接执行和检查的确定性操作分离。它还进一步将实验规划与报告分离，使得在观察结果之前指定所需证据，并根据测量结果修正手稿主张。为了提高长期研究轨迹的可靠性，该系统将确定性完整性检查与自我批评和界限相结合。
tldr: Spark-to-Paper是一个无需独立代理平台的端到端论文生成系统，通过分离模型判断与确定性操作、以及实验规划与报告，并整合完整性检查和自我批评，实现了从研究想法到完整论文的可靠生成。
en_tdlr: Spark-to-Paper is an end-to-end paper generation system that operates without a separate agent platform, enhancing reliability by separating model-based judgment from deterministic operations and experiment planning from reporting, while integrating integrity checks and self-critique.
